scenes.text: Where does heat do its quiet damage?
When you sweat, you lose water and salt. The heart pumps harder to carry heat to the skin, and the kidneys strain, especially when it happens day after day.
People already living with heart, kidney or lung conditions have less room to cope.
That is why many heat deaths are recorded as something else: a failing heart or kidneys, on a hot day.
Heat care is care for long-term illness too.
